title: 第9章 先搞一笔启动资金第1章 武道生异能生
content_zh:
“不是哥们，你真打算去啊？”
杨信有点急了：
“那地方很乱的，打架毫无规则可言，要是受重伤，你拿到的奖金都不够赔医药费，你可别让我在我爸诊所里看见你啊！”
杨信知道王生家庭条件不好，他是真怕自己因为说错一句话，把同班同学给坑死。
那可是每天都会死人的地方！
尽管杨信的确有那么点嫉妒王生的异能，明明大家潜力值都一样，可偏偏王生的异能是看得见的强，对中考帮助不小。
最可恶的是他长了张讨女人欢心的小白脸，这就更让人无法接受了！
但杨信也不是什么小人。
就因为同学走了这么点狗屎运，就使绊子把人害死，犯不上。
“不，我没说要去比赛，只是想当观众，瞧瞧地下拳场的战斗和学校里学的有哪里不一样的，长下见识，顺便看能不能学到什么。”
王生从容答道。
杨信一想也是，野望斗拳场的肉搏战对学生来说，还真就有些启发，上次他去看了一回，学到了不少实战小技巧。
于是杨信这才放心：
“那行，只要你不是去比赛就好。”
很快，天真的杨信就将进入野望斗拳场的方式交代给了王生，还反复嘱咐地址要保密，千万不要和别人乱说。
毕竟是地下的灰色产业，这种东西明面上不允许存在，网上也不可能查到进入方式，基本都靠口口相传。
杨信得知这个地方，也是从他爸接待的那几个伤员那里问出来的，不然一般中学生很难知晓。
‘很好，这下算是有门路了。’
王生心中暗道，这不是瞌睡了就有人送枕头么？
地下黑拳场，可真是一处很好的找死地方。

受伤与死亡对别人来说是唯恐避之不及，对王生来说则是趋之若鹜。
他暗暗将地址牢记，接着又去测试速度。
【本次速度值：11.5ms】
【相较您26天前检测结果（9.8ms）增长1.7ms】
速度的涨幅也很大，但还在正常范畴。
这点倒是没有出乎王生意料，除非他奔跑致死，不然速度层面增长也不可能蹿火箭式地升高。
全部测试完毕，王生和杨信打了声招呼，便径直离开，准备着手进地下拳场的事情。
“王生小弟弟，测试结果怎么样，还满意吗？”
离馆前，大厅的前台小姐忽地叫住他，主动搭话道。
王生顿时身体绷紧了几分，客气道：
“还行，谢谢姐姐关心。”
他驱使着僵硬的身体朝向大门口：
“那什么姐姐，我还有事就先走了。”
“嗯，慢走，欢迎下次再来呀。”
content_en:
"No, buddy, are you really planning to go?"
Yang Xin was a little anxious:
"That place is very chaotic. There are no rules in fighting. If you are seriously injured, the bonus you get will not be enough to pay for medical expenses. Don't let me see you in my dad's clinic!"
Yang Xin knew that Wang Sheng's family situation was not good, and he was really afraid that he would trick his classmates to death because of what he said wrongly.
That's a place where people die every day!
Although Yang Xin is indeed a little jealous of Wang Sheng's abilities, everyone has the same potential, but Wang Sheng's abilities are clearly stronger, which helps a lot in the high school entrance examination.
The most disgusting thing is that he has a pretty face that pleases women, which is even more unacceptable!
But Yang Xin is not a villain.
Just because the classmate had such bad luck, he made the tripper kill someone, which is not a crime.
"No, I didn't say I wanted to compete. I just wanted to be a spectator and see how the fighting in the underground boxing ring is different from what I learned in school. I would like to gain some experience and see if I can learn anything."
Wang Sheng replied calmly.
Yang Xin thought about it. The hand-to-hand combat in the Wild Hope Fighting Arena was really inspiring for students. He went to see it last time and learned a lot of practical skills.
So Yang Xin was relieved:
"That's fine, as long as you're not going to compete."
Soon, the naive Yang Xin told Wang Sheng how to enter the Wild Hope Fighting Arena, and repeatedly told him to keep the address confidential and not to tell anyone else.
After all, it is an underground gray industry. This kind of thing is not allowed to exist on the surface, and it is impossible to find out how to enter it online. It basically relies on word of mouth.
Yang Xin learned about this place from the wounded people his father received, otherwise it would be difficult for ordinary middle school students to know.
‘Very good, now there is a way out. ’
Wang Sheng thought to himself, isn't this why someone gives you a pillow when you feel sleepy?
The underground black boxing ring is really a good place to die.
Injury and death are things that other people avoid, but for Wang Sheng, they flock to them.
He secretly memorized the address and then went to test the speed.
[This time speed value: 11.5ms]
[Compared to your test result 26 days ago (9.8ms), an increase of 1.7ms]
The increase in speed is also very large, but it is still within the normal range.
This was not beyond Wang Sheng's expectation. Unless he ran to death, the speed level would not increase in a rocket-like manner.
After all the tests were completed, Wang Sheng and Yang Xin said hello and left directly, preparing to enter the underground boxing ring.
"Little brother Wang Sheng, how are the test results? Are you satisfied?"
Before leaving the hotel, the lady at the front desk suddenly stopped him and took the initiative to talk to him.
Wang Sheng immediately tensed up a bit and said politely:
"It's okay, thank you sister for your concern."
He drove his stiff body towards the door:
"What about sister, I'll leave first if I have something else to do."
"Well, walk slowly. Welcome to come again next time."
